footer: Compiled from BBC, Reuters, CNBC, India Meteorological Department, Sensor Tower and The Times reports filed on 20 November 2026 (morning, WIB).
sources_note: All seven stories were reported on 20 November 2026; the Trump-Xi-Putin declaration and the ICJ Myanmar verdict were delivered on 19 November and first widely reported in the early hours of 20 November (WIB), and Cyclone Akvan's landfall is forecast for around noon on 20 November, not yet reported at the time of writing.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin issue 'peace declaration' after first trilateral summit
stories.summary: The three leaders ended their 90-minute meeting in Shenzhen with a four-point 'Declaration Towards Peace' pledging dialogue on nuclear risks, more refined petroleum output and UN reform. The statement said nothing about Ukraine, and analysts called it symbolic rather than a breakthrough.

stories.headline: Anthropic closes up 17% at $97.17 in record $81.3bn IPO debut
stories.summary: The Claude maker's shares opened at $111.50, briefly valuing it above $2 trillion, before closing at $97.17 — up 17% on the $83 offer price — in the largest IPO on record. Anthropic raised $81.3 billion selling 980 million shares, alongside a separate $26 billion private placement.

stories.headline: World court rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
stories.summary: The International Court of Justice ruled 9-6 that Myanmar committed genocide during its 2017 crackdown, finding about 10,000 Rohingya were violently killed — the first time a state has been found responsible for genocide. The court ordered reparations and the safe return of refugees, though it has no power to enforce the ruling.

stories.headline: Missiles hit Kyiv in early hours as war grinds on
stories.summary: Explosions were heard across Kyiv in the early hours of Friday, and a fire broke out in a three-storey building in the Obolonskyi district after it was hit by missile debris, the city's mayor said. The strike came a day after a drone attack on the capital killed one person and damaged the Austrian and Dutch embassies.

stories.headline: Cyclone Akvan bears down on India as 300,000 evacuate
stories.summary: More than 300,000 people have been evacuated to shelters in Odisha as Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan approaches the coast, with 69 trains cancelled and hundreds of rescue teams deployed. Landfall is forecast near Gopalpur around noon on Friday, with winds of 90-100 km/h and gusts to 110 km/h.

stories.headline: GTA VI smashes records with estimated $2.36bn first-day sales
stories.summary: Sensor Tower estimates GTA VI sold 24.58 million copies worth about $2.36 billion on its first day — more than double GTA V's 2013 record — with 75% of sales on PlayStation. Take-Two has not yet confirmed official figures, and the online mode and PC version are expected in 2027.

stories.headline: Daily pill hailed as biggest pancreatic cancer advance in decades
stories.summary: A daily pill, daraxonrasib, given with chemotherapy shrank or wiped out tumours in 60.7% of 61 patients with advanced pancreatic cancer, and tumours vanished entirely in about one in 12. Doctors caution the early-phase trial had no control arm and is not a cure, but Cancer Research UK called it the biggest leap forward in decades.
